text:
Katie M.: quick heads-up — embeddings svc spiking 502s on short requests, traced to header parsing bug in v1.2.3. I built v1.2.3-hotfix and want to push a small hotfix within the current change window (10m). Requesting expedited approvals from SRE and security so we can canary ASAP.

Dave R.: oncall ack. Can we do a 5% canary first? need rollback criteria defined.

Katie M.: yes — canary 5%. Rollback if error rate > 1% for 5m OR p95 latency > 500ms. No DB/schema changes. Release note will be tiny.

Jordan S.: security reviewed, no secrets/KMS changes, approve. :white_check_mark:

Liam (oncall): SRE approve for 5% canary. Will monitor. Do we pin image sha?

Katie M.: pin to image sha `sha256:abc123def4567890` and pin routing for canary to eu-west only. Deploy command I'm going to run: `/deploy hotfix v1.2.3-hotfix --image=sha256:abc123def4567890 --canary=5 --regions=eu-west --pin`

Samir K.: added short release note and links: https://docs.internal/releases/1.2.3-hotfix — LGTM. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Deploy job queued by Katie M. — job id 3421. Starting canary rollout: 5% in eu-west. Monitor: errors, p95, CPU.

deploy-bot: Canary progress update (4m): errors 0.2% (baseline 0.3%), p95 120ms, no new 5xx alerts.

Dave R.: looks good from my side. Promote when you're ready. :rocket:

Katie M.: promoting now — rolling staged ramp 25% -> 50% -> 100% over next 10m. will watch metrics closely.

deploy-bot: Promotion started. Stage 1 -> 25% (eu-west + us-central). Job id 3421. Next checks at +2m.

deploy-bot: Stage 2 -> 50% passed. No alerting anomalies.

deploy-bot: Final rollout -> 100% complete. Hotfix deployed.

Katie M.: thanks everyone. documenting in release notes and closing the window. If anything odd, ping me and I'll roll back the pinned image to previous sha.

Liam (oncall): noted. Good job — thanks team.

Samir K.: adding changelog entry and emailing product owners.
